text: {"test_cases": 14, "summary": "Wrote the \"agent_test\" KUnit suite in lib/agent_kunit.c covering equal and case-folded inputs, exact mismatch return values, length 0/1/boundary/SIZE_MAX, NUL and empty strings, unsigned and non-letter bytes, symmetry, and an exhaustive single-byte comparison that checks every pair against an ASCII-folding model; not built or run, since the build and tests can't be run in this session."}

{"test_cases": 16, "summary": "Wrote the \"agent_test\" KUnit suite in lib/agent_kunit.c covering empty and no-match inputs, match at first, middle and last positions, multiple reject characters, repeated and duplicate characters, byte-exact comparison including high-bit bytes, NUL terminators in both subject and reject, a 4096-byte string with matches at several offsets, and consistency with strpbrk(); not compiled or run here, as requested."}

{"test_cases": 11, "summary": "Wrote the \"agent_test\" KUnit suite in lib/agent_kunit.c with 11 cases covering zero and sub-threshold sizes, SI and IEC 1000/1024 boundaries, three-significant-figure rounding and carry, block-size reduction, NO_SPACE/NO_BYTES flags, the 32-bit limit, the YiB and UNK prefixes, and snprintf truncation; expected strings were hand-traced against the code because the build and tests could not be run here."}

{"test_cases": 20, "summary": "Wrote the \"agent_test\" KUnit suite in lib/agent_kunit.c covering string_escape_mem's escape classes, their priority, the @only dictionary and ESCAPE_APPEND, source length limits, and destination truncation at every size with a sentinel check for overruns; it has not been compiled or run."}
